encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: μετὰ Καράβου σύνεισιν, ὃς μόνος βροτῶν
ἅθρους τεμαχίτας, ὥστ᾽ ἐνεῖναι μηδὲ ἕν.

div.note: Athenaeus 8, 340 d Εὔβουλος δ᾽ ἐν Ἀνασῳζομένοις κτλ.
1. ἕταιροι A. τοῖς θεοῖσι Casaub. θεοισέχθροισι vel θηρίοισι Herwerd. Nov. add. crit. 24. 2. μόνος βροτῶν μόνος A. 4. ἁδροὺς Dindf. τεμαχήτας A. ἀνεῖναι Dobr. ὥστε μεῖναι Coraes.

varia helluonum genera describuntur: alii carne delectantur, alii cum Callimedonte Carabo (cf. Antiph. 26, 5) piscibus. συμπεπλεγμένοι, ut Herodot. 3, 78. Demosth. 9, 51 συμπλακέντας διαγωνίζεσθαι. hic ridicule ὀψοφάγοι digladiari dicuntur — non cum deis sine dubio, sed cum piscibus. scribendum enim ἕτεροι δὲ δὴ θύννοισι συμπεπλ., qui quam accepti fuerint Atheniensibus sexcentiens testantur comici.
